question: Which customers are exposed if supplier S-104 misses its next ship date? Show the affected products and the top 10 accounts and payers by volume on them.
answer:
S-104's next ship date is **7 Oct 2026**, on PO005791 for 4,200 units of RM-221 (Polysorbate 80 NF, low-peroxide). If that PO slips, the exposure is the **cyclosporine dry-eye franchise**: three commercial packs with **13,986 TRx in the last 13 weeks** (3 Jul to 25 Sep 2026). Eight health systems account for most of that volume, and five of them have supply contracts.

**What makes this a real risk**
- **S-104** is Delmar Specialty Chemicals, a tier-2 supplier in India. It shipped 32.3% of its 96 closed POs late (ratified `late_ship_rate`).
- **No backup source:** S-104 is the only qualified source for RM-221. The alternate supplier, S-131, isn't qualified. The next step in the chain, the emulsifier premix CMP-310, also has a single source (S-201).
- **Slow recovery:** from when RM-221 ships, it takes about **50 days** for finished Lacrivia 5 mL to reach the DC. That includes a 14-day sterility test (BR-LEAD-01). So an on-time 7 Oct shipment reaches the DC around 26 Nov at the earliest, and every day of delay pushes that out a day. I only pulled lead times for Lacrivia 5 mL; the other packs share the same upstream steps.
- **No substitute:** the approved substitute for Lacrivia is Cyclosporine OS, but it depends on the same RM-221 supply (BR-SUB-01).

**Affected products (current bill of materials only)**
| NDC | Product | TRx, last 13 weeks |
|---|---|---|
| 99101-0101-05 | Lacrivia 0.1% emulsion 5 mL | 7,017 |
| 99101-0101-10 | Lacrivia 0.1% emulsion 10 mL | 3,425 |
| 99101-0202-05 | Cyclosporine 0.05% emulsion 5 mL | 3,544 |
| FG-3001 to FG-3011 | Lens care solutions 1–11 | Not in the commercial database (no prescription data) |

The lens care products are also exposed, but their customers would be wholesalers (from shipment data), not accounts or payers.

**Top 10 customers by TRx on the three affected packs**
Clinics are rolled up to their health system (BR-CUST-01).
| # | Account | Type, state | TRx | Share | Contract tier |
|---|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Oak Hollow Health System | Health system, NY | 1,731 | 12.4% | A |
| 2 | Riverbend Health System | Health system, CA | 1,609 | 11.5% | A |
| 3 | Northfield Health System | Health system, NJ | 1,532 | 11.0% | A |
| 4 | Sunridge Health System | Health system, OH | 1,511 | 10.8% | B |
| 5 | Brightwater Health System | Health system, FL | 1,418 | 10.1% | – |
| 6 | Stonegate Health System | Health system, MN | 1,200 | 8.6% | – |
| 7 | Clearview Health System | Health system, OH | 1,068 | 7.6% | B (expires 31 Dec 2026) |
| 8 | Willow Creek Health System | Health system, MN | 701 | 5.0% | – |
| 9 | Sunridge Vision Associates 20 | Independent clinic, PA | 248 | 1.8% | – |
| 10 | Glenmoor Vision Associates 12 | Independent clinic, CA | 246 | 1.8% | – |

These ten make up 80.5% of the volume. If supply runs short, BR-ALLOC-01 sets the order: tier A contracts first, then tier B, then everyone else pro rata by last-13-week TRx.

**Top 10 payers by TRx on the same packs**
| # | Payer | Channels | TRx | Share |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | Northstar Health | Commercial, Part D, Managed Medicaid, Exchange | 1,635 | 11.7% |
| 2 | Bluecrest Mutual | Commercial, Part D, Exchange | 1,630 | 11.7% |
| 3 | Silverline Health | Commercial, Part D, Exchange | 1,427 | 10.2% |

These ten make up 80.0% of the volume.

**Not counted above:** S-104 also supplies RM-222, which feeds Oculon 2.5 mL (2,568 TRx) and 5 mL (986 TRx). That material isn't on the 7 Oct PO; its next ship date is 26 Oct (PO000430), and it has a qualified alternate supplier (S-130). It only becomes a risk if that later PO also slips and S-130 can't cover it.

**Sources and definitions**
- **Knowledge layer:** `get_context` (join paths "Supplier to finished goods" and "PackagedProduct to customers and payers"; rules BR-CUST-01, BR-LEAD-01, BR-ALLOC-01, BR-SUB-01), `trace_supply_exposure(S-104)`, `get_lead_times(RM-221 → FG-1001)` and reference set `supply_contracts`.
- **Supply data (Fabric):** `dbo.PURCH_ORD` and `dbo.SUPPLIER`. I didn't use the deprecated tables `BOM_FLAT_LEGACY` and `PURCH_ORD_ARCHIVE`, and the trace skipped an old RM-221 → CMP-320 link that ended 30 Jun 2025.
- **Commercial data (Snowflake):** `RAW_3P.RXT_WKLY` (TRx, the 13 most recent weeks), `CORE.PRESCRIBER`, `CORE.ACCOUNT` (rolled up through up to three levels of parent account) and `CORE.PAYER_SPINE` (plans grouped to payer).

**Assumptions**
- "Next ship date" means the open S-104 PO with the earliest promised ship date.
- Volume means TRx.
- A customer is the top-level contracted account, per BR-CUST-01.
- No policy restrictions applied to this request.
